items.title: PepsiCo Stock And Other Defensive Value Picks For Higher Rates
items.summary: Fed officials are openly debating whether rates need to climb again, and that raises the stakes for U.S. large caps that rely on stable funding costs and steady consumer demand. When policy makers talk about getting “behind the curve” on inflation, investors who react late risk watching others reposition first. items.title: What Should Investors Know About McCormick (MKC) Merger Investigation?
items.summary: Halper Sadeh LLC said it is investigating McCormick (NYSE: MKC) over its planned merger with Unilever's Foods business. The law firm is reviewing whether McCormick's directors complied with their fiduciary duties in evaluating and approving the transaction. The probe focuses on whether McCormick shareholders are receiving fair value and adequate disclosure regarding the Unilever Foods deal.
